set -e; git fetch origin main --prune; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]; then echo DIRTY_TRACKED; git status --short; exit 12; fi; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); python3 -m py_compile tools/run_research_distillery.py tools/run_research_distillery_entry.py tools/run_24h_entityos_swarm.py tools/free_swarm_quota.py; python3 - <<'PY'
import os,signal
me=os.getpid()
for n in os.listdir('/proc'):
 if not n.isdigit() or int(n)==me: continue
 try: args=[x.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in open('/proc/'+n+'/cmdline','rb').read().split(b'\0') if x]
 except: continue
 if any(a.endswith('tools/run_research_distillery_entry.py') for a in args[:5]):
  try: os.kill(int(n),signal.SIGTERM)
  except ProcessLookupError: pass
PY
sleep 1; export CLAY_FREE_ONLY_ATTESTED=1; nohup python3 tools/run_research_distillery_entry.py --hours 24 --sleep-seconds 3 >/artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/distillery.log 2>&1 </dev/null & echo PID=$!; sleep 20; ps -eo pid,etime,%cpu,%mem,args | grep '[r]un_research_distillery_entry.py' | head -5; echo ---STATUS---; cat /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/distillery/STATUS.json 2>/dev/null || true; echo ---LOG---; tail -60 /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/distillery.log 2>/dev/null || true
